RODAR.VAZIO: No published, enabled Run by hand flow.

EDITOR.ERROS_NOS: {n} step(s) marked in red on the board.
EDITOR.EXCLUIR_MSG: The design, versions and run history go away. This cannot be undone.
EDITOR.SEM_EXECUCOES: No runs yet. Use Test with a lead… to see the path.
EDITOR.SELECIONE: Click a step to configure it.

PAINEL.AVISO_RASCUNHO: Goes out as a DRAFT note in the conversation. A person sends it.
PAINEL.VARIAVEIS_AJUDA: Click a variable to insert it in the text.
PAINEL.ESPERAR_REUNIAO_AJUDA: Counts back from the meeting time. If that moment has already passed, it does not wait and sets Wait time already passed = yes.
PAINEL.ESPERAR_CONVERSA: An amount of time after the conversation was created
PAINEL.ESPERAR_CONVERSA_AJUDA: Counts from when the conversation was created. If that moment has already passed, it does not wait and sets Wait time already passed = yes.
PAINEL.PARA_CLOSER_SDR: Lead Closer and SDR (neither: the administrators)
PAINEL.JANELA_AJUDA: São Paulo time. Unchanged, the default applies: Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm.
PAINEL.SO_PARA_FRENTE: Only forward (a lead already past this stage stays)
PAINEL.SO_SE_VAZIO: Only if the lead does not have one yet
PAINEL.TAREFA_DA_REUNIAO: Task of the meeting itself (due at the meeting time, owned by who booked it)
PAINEL.ONDE_CONVERSA: In the conversation (or the lead notes, without a conversation)
PAINEL.APAGAR_REUNIAO_AJUDA: Deletes the meeting task of the cancelled meeting (and stops its reminders).
PAINEL.REGISTRAR_RETOMADA_AJUDA: Counts the attempt on the lead (the same counter as the panel and the Prepare follow-up button) and stamps the date: the next follow-up only after 5 days. The tentativa variable keeps the logged number.
PAINEL.UMA_VEZ_POR_DIA: Only once a day (the first run of the day notifies; the others do not)
PAINEL.MOTIVO_OUTRO_PLACEHOLDER: Describe it in a few words
PAINEL.CANCELAR_ETAPA: Cancel if the lead leaves the stage
PAINEL.MANUAL_AJUDA: Runs when someone triggers it — for now in Test with a lead…, Run for real button.
PAINEL.OUTRO_AJUDA: The other output takes whatever matched no case.
PAINEL.PERGUNTA_AJUDA: The AI reads the conversation and the lead and answers yes or no. The reason becomes the resposta_ia variable.
PAINEL.INSTRUCAO_AJUDA: Goes out as a DRAFT note. The AI follows the bar rules and never promises results, deadlines or amounts.
PAINEL.RESERVA_IA_AJUDA: Empty = retries in 1, 5 and 15 minutes, then reports the failure. Filled = uses this text right away, also as a draft.
PAINEL.SKILL_AJUDA: The skill only thinks: it does not act on the conversation. The result becomes a private note and the resposta_ia variable.
PAINEL.SEM_CAPTAIN: Could not list the Captain assistants.
PAINEL.ADVBOX_AVISO: Really writes to ADVBOX, on the lead case created at closing.
PAINEL.ADVBOX_PRAZO: Due (days from today, empty = no due date)
PAINEL.ADVBOX_INDISPONIVEL: ADVBOX did not answer. Try again in a moment.
PAINEL.WEBHOOK_AJUDA: Sends only the lead name, phone, stage, thesis, source, channel, value, priority and owner as JSON — never free fields or documents. Always the last step.
PAINEL.CHAVE_CAMPO_AJUDA: Lowercase letters, numbers and _. It becomes a variable with the same name.
PAINEL.DIAS_PARADO: Stalled for more than how many days
PAINEL.DIAS_PARADO_AJUDA: Empty = each stage stalled limit. Each lead enters once per stall.
PAINEL.RETOMADA: Follow-up: every day while still stalled
PAINEL.RETOMADA_AJUDA: Only leads with a conversation, no open follow-up task and the last follow-up 5 or more days ago, in pipeline order. Unchecked: each lead enters once per stall.
PAINEL.GRUPO_AJUDA: No stage selected = open leads. Runs once a day.
PAINEL.REUNIAO_AJUDA: Works for Cal.com and the lead panel. Rescheduling counts as scheduled.
PAINEL.DOCUMENTO_AJUDA: When the AI matches an attachment to a checklist item. Confirmation stays with the team.

CAMPOS.horario_passou: Wait time already passed (yes or no)
CAMPOS.primeira_resposta: Conversation already got its first reply (yes or no)

ERROS.SETA_FANTASMA: An arrow points to a step that does not exist ({id}).

ERROS.SOLTO: This step is not connected to the trigger.
ERROS.SE_SEM_SAIDA: Connect at least one output (yes or no).
ERROS.ESCOLHA_CHAVE_REPETIDA: Two cases with the same output.
ERROS.ESCOLHA_VALOR_REPETIDO: The same value is in two cases.
ERROS.JANELA_INVALIDA: Invalid hours: pick at least one day and a start before the end.
ERROS.CHATWOOT_MENSAGEM: Messages to the client only as drafts.
ERROS.CHATWOOT_PROIBIDA: Action not allowed in a flow ({nome}).
ERROS.ADVBOX_DESCRICAO: The movement needs at least 10 letters.
ERROS.WEBHOOK_HTTPS: The address must start with https.
ERROS.WEBHOOK_ULTIMO: The webhook must be the last step.
ERROS.CAMPO_CHAVE: Field name only with lowercase letters, numbers and _, and not a name the hub already uses (nome, etapa, telefone…).

TESTAR.AJUDA: Dry run: runs the draft on real data, skips waits and only describes the actions — nothing is executed.
TESTAR.BUSCAR: Search lead by name or phone

TESTAR.ERRO: Could not run the dry run.
TESTAR.NAO_RODOU: Did not run: the flow must be on, published and under today's limit.
